summary.text: Assimilation Wind Song is Feng Jiu Ge's last-resort immortal killer move. It summons the winds of assimilation, the number one wind in the world.

claims.text: Prince Feng Xian tells Le Yao that what shocked him in a secret spar was not Feng Jiu Ge’s rank eight battle strength, but an unprecedented immortal killer move Feng Jiu Ge named Assimilation Wind Song. At Lang Ya blessed land, with separation song useless and complete silence denying his sound-path options, Feng Jiu Ge takes the risk and activates it. Intense winds rise that are not golden wind, Luo Po wind, or the other listed famous winds: they are the winds of assimilation, able to assimilate everything, with few counters. Those winds appear when immortal apertures are destroyed; human records had never shown a person personally controlling them until Feng Jiu Ge did so.

Among his seven songs, obtain treasure song and towards heaven song assist cultivation; green jade song, heaven and earth song, submission song, and separation song are fight trump cards; Assimilation Wind Song is the final one, held unless necessary. Failure to activate it would destroy him first through the winds of assimilation. Song warrior can turn many of his songs into clones, but not this one. Ordinary methods that touch the wind are assimilated and become fuel that makes it stronger and larger. Fang Yuan had already warned Lang Ya land spirit about the move from future memory of the five regions chaotic war, which steadies morale when the wind appears inside the blessed land.

He can summon the winds of assimilation but cannot manipulate them; methods used on the wind only strengthen it through assimilation. Once the move is used he must leave the center, or he dies when the wind fills the space. Song warrior still cannot clone Assimilation Wind Song. Fang Yuan rates the chaotic-war form as shocking and widely feared, and notes that the version Feng Jiu Ge uses at Lang Ya is not that complete version. Even so, while Feng Jiu Ge was still rank seven the move had already driven rank eight Gu Immortals to research counters such as true stability transformation.
